integrity: The infinite asymptotic is proved analytically. The numerical program checks finite identities and sample limits only.
scientific_limitations: Only alpha=0 is asserted positive and trace class. For shifts other than zero, only the canonical finite-section trace limit is proved. The classical bounded-Hausdorff subnormality theorem is cited, not reproved. The full text of a 2024 factorization paper was not accessible for comprehensive priority checking.
title: A fractional-order Cesàro commutator trace and a shift-invariant boundary flux
